report_identity.warning: full and source are separate profiling runs. Source PC totals (7999) must never be combined with the full report's PC total.

sampling.note: base stalled_* categories sum exactly to the denominator; *_not_issued are subsets and are excluded

source_pins.note: Native listed-order tree hash metadata is preserved unchanged; the label method claims sorted order but only listed order reproduces. Cite tree_sha256_sorted and the per-file hashes above as the separately sorted source closure.

observations: Source PC samples (denominator 7999) are dominated by stalled_wait 2507 (31.34%) and stalled_barrier 897 (11.21%); long_scoreboard is 523 (6.54%).
DRAM throughput is 10.117% of peak and the L2 hit rate is 81.856%; the kernel is not DRAM-bandwidth bound.

Resident occupancy is 12.928% versus a 16.667% theoretical ceiling (2 CTAs/SM, 8 of 48 warps), but only 0.368 warps/cycle are eligible and 32.026% of cycles issue. Resident occupancy and eligible-warp rate are different measurements.

SASS is vectorized: LDG.E.128 and LDS.128 move 16 B per lane, so a full 32-lane warp request is 512 B. Measured shared-load wavefronts per instruction are 4.044, consistent with the legitimate 4 x 128 B wavefronts; derived excessive wavefronts = 0. A generic 4-sector scalar ideal is not applicable to these global vector loads.

FP16 local spill traffic is real: 197824 local loads / 88704 local stores, 98.8183% local load-sector hit rate, and 12 direct LDL/STL PCs carrying 83/7999 base PC samples. That small direct PC share is not the total spill runtime share.
